comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Phase 1 RCA — CONFIRMED defect, before any repair.

Proven mechanism: the ordinary-write gate at `src/rebar/llm/enrich_drain.py:313-321` needs only a boolean, but calls `pending_enrichment()`. `src/rebar/llm/overlap/queue.py:194-205` eagerly enumerates every ticket directory and calls `reduce_ticket`; `reduce_ticket:158-165` then resolves the already-canonical directory and performs three independent `_latest` probes, each of which lists that directory (`queue.py:91-100,127-165`). Therefore the no-pending common path scales with the entire 4,371-ticket store rather than queue work.

Runtime proof: direct live probes returned zero pending but took 453.676, 467.151, 437.443, 479.934, and 504.079 ms. cProfile observed 4,371 `reduce_ticket`, 13,113 `_event_names`/per-ticket list calls, and 2,302 event reads; `posix.listdir` alone consumed 313 ms of a 488 ms run. A discriminating zero-event synthetic sweep (two warmups + five samples) produced N=0: 0.014 ms; N=500: 23.101 ms; N=2,000: 91.055 ms; N=4,371: 201.779 ms, with exactly N reduces, 3N event-name scans, and zero event reads. That linear result confirms total-ticket enumeration alone breaches 20 ms by 500 empty ticket dirs and rules out queue-history JSON, pending volume, config, or imports as the necessary cause.

Amplifier experiments: a behavior-equivalent one-directory-scan probe matched all 4,371 ticket states and the pending set exactly, reduced per-probe ticket-directory scans 13,113→4,371, and improved live mean 758.550→224.449 ms, still >20. An identity-resolution + top-level scandir probe likewise matched all 4,371 states/pending exactly and improved 480.801→309.684 ms, still >20. Thus triple listdir and redundant resolve/stat are real amplifiers, but neither is the sole cause. Runtime profiling and counter instrumentation observed the mechanism executing; no production instrumentation or edits remain.

Defect legitimacy: `defect`. The closed design story `leggy-heedless-mosquito` explicitly set `DRAIN_GATE_BUDGET_MS=20` and required the no-pending write-path gate to finish within it; `src/rebar/llm/config.py:147-151` still calls 20 ms the cheap gate-check budget, and `enrich_drain.py:316-321` reports the breach. Commit 9af88c3 removed a flaky wall-clock CI assertion, not the production contract. Prior ticket ea2a / commit 3701dcbe3b explicitly said its bounded-open repair left `listdir` dominance and this separate budget defect unresolved.

Parsimonious cause: `pending_enrichment` is an exact all-candidate query built on per-ticket directories, but `maybe_drain` uses it as a constant-budget boolean gate on every write; the query/data-access shape at `queue.py:194-205` is not bounded by queue size or a queue-specific index. No repair has begun. Next gate: prove a remediation can preserve eligibility, soak/claim/done semantics, and caller behavior; any change to when enrichment runs or consistency is an operator decision.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Caller-dependency gate + decision checkpoint. Serena and string-reference sweeps found two production `pending_enrichment` consumers: `drain()` needs the complete sorted candidates for batch/claim processing (`enrich_drain.py:204-230`); `maybe_drain()` only needs a boolean (`:313-326`) and is reached after durable push from both write paths. Expected repair contract: <=20 ms caller gate, identical soak/latest-enqueue/done/lease/claim eligibility, complete drain candidates, no missed enqueue.

Behavior-equivalent stateless probes cannot meet that contract: one shared directory scan preserved all 4,371 states but averaged 224 ms; identity+scandir preserved all states but averaged 310 ms; Git tracked-path enumeration alone costs 12-16 ms, and an exact Git-index candidate reducer preserved all 771 queue-ticket states but averaged 69.5 ms. No caller depends on slowness, but callers do depend on exact eligibility/list semantics.

Therefore repair now requires operator-approved design/behavior: (A, recommended) move the exact scan off the caller into a detached coalesced gate/drain child, preserving the event log and reducer but allowing a child launch when no item qualifies; (B) add a persistent derived HEAD-keyed queue-state index with explicit atomicity/invalidation/rebuild policy; (C) accept ~70 ms and raise the 20 ms budget; or (D) disable/scope opportunistic drain. A avoids a second consistency model but needs a bounded-spawn/lock-coalescing contract and changes when the eligibility check executes. Per directive, implementation stops here pending operator review. No production/test edits or plan review have begun.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
## Verification-then-close: the mechanism this bug proved was fixed by a02eedbb6e (ticket 958e-f4b3)

This ticket's Phase-1 RCA proved the mechanism — `maybe_drain`'s boolean gate calling `pending_enrichment()`, which enumerates every ticket directory, making the ordinary-write gate O(ticket count). That exact mechanism was repaired under bug `moist-short-lionfish` (958e-f4b3-275c-4154, "enrich drain gate check is O(ticket count), blowing its 20 ms budget on every write"), whose fix landed on origin/main as commit a02eedbb6e ("Make the enrich drain gate O(1) on a quiet store", trailer `rebar-ticket: 958e-f4b3-275c-4154`; verified reachable from origin/main).

Verified in the working tree: `src/rebar/llm/overlap/queue.py` now carries the O(1) fast-path gate marker (`_GATE_MARKER_NAME = "enrich-gate.json"`, TTL-bounded via `_GATE_MARKER_TTL_NS`, invalidated on every queue append via `_clear_gate_marker`). 958e-f4b3 is closed.

Linked `relates_to` 958e-f4b3. This ticket's RCA dossier (mechanism, profiles, option analysis A–D) fed that repair; the marker design corresponds to caching the "nothing pending" answer rather than rescanning. Residual known limitation — the marker is all-or-nothing, so one standing pending entry disables the fast path store-wide — is separately filed as open ticket 4144-75d3 (`tireless-convenable-canvasback`), so it is not lost by this close.

Closing as resolved-by 958e-f4b3 / a02eedbb6e.

## Context / observed warning
Tracker writes repeatedly emit:

`WARNING rebar.llm.enrich_drain: enrich drain gate check took 300–500 ms (> 20 ms budget)`

A closed ticket (`verymad-hard-weaverbird`) recorded the same observation at 300–800 ms but explicitly left it separate. No open bug owns this warning. The warning occurs on ordinary write paths where the feature gate is intended to be cheap.

## Investigation and repair protocol
- Use `rebar-debug` in a fresh worktree from current `origin/main`.
- Reproduce the latency with deterministic instrumentation or a bounded measurement that isolates the gate check from unrelated tracker work.
- Build an evidence dossier, propose falsifiable causes, and confirm the runtime mechanism before changing production code.
- Establish defect legitimacy against the documented 20 ms budget and run the caller-dependency gate.
- If a defect is proven and remediation does not require a behavioral/design decision, repair via physically withheld RED-oracle TDD, run the relevant and full gates, send through Gerrit, and close only after both votes are green and the change lands.
- If remediation changes when enrichment runs, its consistency guarantees, or another user-visible behavior, stop with a decision brief for operator approval.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The warning is reproduced and its root cause is proven with runtime evidence and exact citations.
- [ ] The ticket records whether the behavior is a defect against the 20 ms contract or needs an operator decision.
- [ ] For an autonomous defect repair, a mechanism-level regression test is observed RED before the fix, physically withheld from the fixer, GREEN afterward, and shown to fail under a defect-seeded mutation.
- [ ] The original warning scenario is replicated after remediation and meets the documented budget without weakening enrichment correctness.
- [ ] Construct and surface-parity siblings receive explicit dispositions.
- [ ] Any code change passes local gates, Gerrit LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, lands, and only then is the ticket closed.
